_comment: Placeholder templates with FAKE addresses -- copy this file to modbus_templates.json and replace with real values from your device's own Modbus register map documentation (e.g. a Kamstrup Multical meter manual, a Phoenix Contact energy meter manual). Don't trust the example addresses below against a real device. modbus_templates.json is tracked in git like this file -- a device's register map is public manufacturer documentation, not site-specific data.

templates.name: Example Energy Meter (EDIT ME -- fake addresses)
templates.description: Placeholder only. Replace unit_id and each register's function_code/address/quantity with the real values from your specific meter model's documentation before trusting any result.

registers.label: Example: Active Energy (kWh)
registers.note: Placeholder -- e.g. a 32-bit IEEE float across 2 registers, per your meter's manual. Omit data_type for plain integer registers.
